# Arduino IDE third-party projects

Projects in this section are intended to be reproducible from the Arduino IDE, normally using the Espressif ESP32 Arduino core.

The goal is not to mirror every external sketch. The goal is to document a reproducible upstream baseline and then compare it with the board-specific API provided by this repository.

## Projects

- [`sukesh-minimal-lovyangfx/`](sukesh-minimal-lovyangfx/) — minimal WT32-SC01-PLUS display/touch sketch using LovyanGFX and `ESP32S3 Dev Module`; first comparison target for the video series.
